description: Estimate reclaimable team capacity and illustrative payback from user-supplied workload assumptions. Omit unsupplied optional inputs: the server defaults to 60% automatable share and 48 working weeks. Ask for missing people, weekly hours per person, or loaded hourly cost; do not invent assumptions. Use for operational planning, not guaranteed savings or financial advice.

automatableShare.description: Fraction of repetitive time that can be reclaimed (0.6 means 60%). Omit when the user supplies no value; the server defaults to 0.6. Preserve an explicit user value; do not invent a different percentage.

implementationCost.description: Implementation cost in the same currency as hourly labor cost. Omit unless supplied or approved by the user; omitted cost means no payback estimate.

loadedHourlyCost.description: Loaded hourly labor cost in the user's stated currency, supplied by the user.

people.description: Number of people supplied by the user.

weeklyHoursPerPerson.description: Weekly hours each person spends on this workflow, supplied by the user.

workingWeeks.description: Working weeks per year. Omit when the user supplies no value; the server defaults to 48. Preserve an explicit user value; do not substitute calendar weeks.
